Test coverage improved across validation and scan paths.
Various known bugs addressed.
npm publish workflow (`npm-publish.yml`) — publishes `@evnx/cli` to npmjs.com on each tagged release.
PyPI publish workflow (`python-publish.yml`) — publishes `evnx` to PyPI via maturin on each tagged release.
Multiple initial commands revised with updated arguments and behaviour.
`evnx add` command for adding variables to `.env` interactively from custom input, service blueprints, or templates.

14+ format targets for `evnx convert`: JSON, YAML, Shell, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS Secrets Manager, GCP Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, Heroku, Vercel, Railway, Doppler.
Secret pattern detection enhanced with improved entropy analysis.
Error messages for validation failures made more actionable.
CLI documentation expanded.
Windows path handling corrected.
False positives in GitHub token detection reduced.
Validation on large `.env` files approximately 3x faster.

releases.summary: Initial public release.

highlights.text: `evnx init` — stack and service based interactive project setup.
`evnx validate` — basic validation engine (placeholders, weak secrets, misconfigurations).
`evnx scan` — core secret scanning with pattern matching.
`evnx diff` — comparison between `.env` and `.env.example`.
`evnx convert` — basic format conversion.
`evnx sync` — bidirectional sync between `.env` and `.env.example`.
